prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Paint the attached paint_mask_guide.png exactly according to this brief. Inputs in order: design_reference.png is appearance/detail reference; icon_x8.png is binding original colour/design reference (ignore magenta background); paint_mask_guide.png is the EDIT TARGET, preserve all silhouettes, positions, scale, orientation and empty cells exactly. Output 1536x2048 transparent PNG, 3:4.

# Elite Dagger: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10029/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the original isolated and mechanically upright MM9 PCX, which is binding for the design. Preserve the narrow straight pale blade, ornate asymmetrical orange-gold curled guard, pale horizontally banded grip, and wide pale cap pommel. Render one complete vertical Elite Dagger in restrained MM6-MM8 inventory style on genuine transparent alpha. Do not replace it with a generic dagger..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully repaint the original isolated and mechanically upright MM9 PCX, which is binding for the design. Preserve the narrow straight pale blade, ornate asymmetrical orange-gold curled guard, pale horizontally banded grip, and wide pale cap pommel. Render one complete vertical Elite Dagger in restrained MM6-MM8 inventory style on genuine transparent alpha. Do not replace it with a generic dagger.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10029/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

CORRECTION: The previous attempt had ragged silhouettes and scattered red/yellow pixels outside objects. Strictly use the original grey guide alpha boundaries. All pixels outside the exact guide silhouettes must be fully transparent; no specks, fringes, scribbles or bleed. Upper half contains ONLY painted objects, absolutely no red/yellow material-mask contamination. Lower half contains clean solid material zones within exact silhouettes. Preserve the guide's narrow straight blade outline, without widening or irregular edges. Ivory/bone grip and pommel are matte solid yellow in material views; metal blade and gold guard are pure red. Generate clean exact edges.
validation: Visible stray pixels and material colour fringes remain after the single allowed correction; raw output preserved without edits.
